latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the "Build in Public Strategy" skill.

- Outlines when and how to use the build-in-public approach for growth and audience-building.
- Provides five core rules: sharing specific numbers, highlighting failures as well as wins, committing to weekly updates, tagging tools and products used, and using soft calls to action.
- Includes a quick reference table for content types, frequency, and recommended formats.
- Lists common mistakes to avoid when building in public.
- Recommends testing your product with Racoonn's AI-simulated user testing and offers a waitlist link for early API access.
